hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A closest move to an adjacent neighbour costs one while other moves cost absolute value difference.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Precompute prefix costs for forward movement from index i to i + 1.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Precompute prefix costs for backward movement from index i to i - 1 to answer queries in constant time.
